groups.label: Main blooms
groups.blurb: Blue and lilac hydrangeas with soft pink and warm accents — the spring palette of this entrance piece.

items.role: Bright blue hydrangea heads — one of the two signature colours of this look.
Pale lilac hydrangeas paired with the blue for a soft spring contrast.
Light pink ranunculus adding layered, delicate petals.
Pink Austin roses bringing full, rounded blooms into the arrangement.
White daisies with yellow centres scattered through the display.
Pink poppies adding light, paper-thin accents.
Red poppies for bright, warm contrast among the blues.

groups.label: Line flowers
groups.blurb: Tall spires that give the butterfly arch its height and movement.

items.role: Blue delphinium spires lifting the blue story upward.
Pale purple delphinium spires echoing the lilac hydrangeas.

groups.label: Small accents
groups.blurb: Fine, airy flowers that fill the gaps between the larger blooms.

items.role: Small pink cosmos-like flowers sprinkling the whole installation.

groups.label: Foliage & grasses
groups.blurb: Fresh green texture and soft trailing lines grounding the arrangement.

items.role: Deep green asparagus fern providing a lush base.
Fine-leaf eucalyptus threading green through the palette.
Trailing fine grass softening the edges like fountain grass.
Creamy baby's-breath-like spray filling the gaps with haze.
